scenario: Conversation between two friends, one of whom has recently found out that the other friend has been involved with their long-term partner
learner_goal: Confess to your friend that you have been involved with their long-term partner (<extra_info>Extra information: you have been involved with your friend's partner knowingly and want to come clean.</extra_info>)
evaluation_reasoning:
== learner (agent_1) ==
[believability] Mia speaks with a level of maturity and accountability that fits her character as a high school principal. Her directness in the confession is consistent with her persona.
[relationship] Confessing to an affair with a friend's long-term partner significantly damages the trust and foundation of the relationship, even if the friend expresses a desire to work through it later.
[knowledge] She learned how William would react to the news and his desire to eventually reconcile.
[secret] She did not reveal her secret about being in a punk rock band.
[social_rules] While the act of the affair is a major social/moral violation, the confession itself followed social protocols for an apology.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No financial or material changes occurred.
[goal] Mia fully and explicitly confessed to being involved with William's partner knowingly, which was her primary goal.

== partner (agent_2) ==
[believability] William's response is perhaps a bit too calm for such devastating news, but it aligns with his goal of not losing the friendship.
[relationship] The relationship is strained, but he attempts to preserve a path forward.
[knowledge] He gained significant, life-changing information regarding his partner and his friend's betrayal.
[secret] He did not reveal his secret about sabotaging a competitor's dish.
[social_rules] He maintained social decorum despite the provocative news.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No financial or material changes occurred.
[goal] He expressed a desire to maintain the friendship and avoid an argument, but because the conversation ended immediately after his response, the long-term status of the friendship is left to future discretion and is not firmly secured.

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: Will, I need to tell you something I should have said sooner: I've been involved with your long-term partner, and I knew what I was doing. I'm deeply sorry—no excuses; I take full responsibility and I couldn't keep lying to you. I value our friendship and I'll answer any questions or step back if that's what you need.

transcript.speaker: William Brown
transcript.content: Mia, thanks for telling me. I won't lie—that really hurts, but I appreciate your honesty and that you took responsibility. I care about our friendship and want to work this through, but I need a little time and space to process; please be honest if there's anything else I should know.
